title: 3423. Maximum Difference Between Adjacent Elements in a Circular Array

examples.explanation: Because nums is circular, nums[0] and nums[2] are adjacent. They have the maximum absolute difference of |4 - 1| = 3.
The adjacent elements nums[0] and nums[1] have the maximum absolute difference of |-5 - (-10)| = 5.
